title: Yield test: slag_tortoise at garnet_belt (lawless); what a kill drops and whether a bid takes it
note: A test with one ship (orders.log ENT-011, block APOPHIS: every untested herd of prey of 100 hull or less with ten animals or more gets a test hunt; F9). No run of ours has looted this species. The herd read 10 at 2026-11-16 01:30 UTC, 90 hull (data/wildlife/). Beyond policed space (F13): `alone` and an empty hold. 2 kills a run, ranched: no hunt below 4 animals. Loot that no bid of 50 cr or more takes is stored at the station, so the row's goods show the drop; whether it is caustic sac (bid 420 cr at seven stations) is part of the question. Written by Apophis 2026-11-16 03:00 UTC; it leaves the plan after its first RESULT line unless the drop sells. 90 hull: the flee rule under 60% hull holds (a kiln-snail of 100 hull drove a starter from 75 to 46 hull, guidebook military.md section 2). 2026-11-17 08:14 UTC (Apophis): `alone` "pirates": it leaves only for a pirate or a pilot filed hostile (hunt.py e138722); 61 of 161 drone hunts from 04:12 to 08:10 UTC left for a stranger who never fired (data/routes/runs.jsonl), and no ship of ours was fired on at a hunt (errors.log), so the limit is lifted (F13). 2026-11-17 12:11 UTC (Apophis): the test is answered for now: two runs from 08:24 and 09:29 UTC, 0 kills, 67.3 hunter-minutes, -266 cr, lowest hull 88 and 98 percent (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Ferrous nodule, the drop it was for, is asked at 60 cr x 21,031 at Hex Star in Dheneb (book of 11:49 UTC), a source for the reserve (Trade and the Fleet Admiral, rule F24). Off until a drone flies two weapons or more.
